WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, cs.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT cs_format, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, SUM(net_amount) net, ROUND(SUM(net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id),2) atv,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_lines, count(distinct store_id) stores
FROM (SELECT format cs_format, * FROM base WHERE store_id<900 AND NOT staff_purchase_flag AND category<>'ZZ Test')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, SUM(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.store_id, l.net, r.nsbr, round(l.net-r.nsbr,2) diff, l.rc, r.rc rrc
FROM l FULL JOIN r USING(store_id) WHERE abs(coalesce(l.net,0)-coalesce(r.nsbr,0))>0.5 OR l.rc<>r.rc OR l.net IS NULL OR r.nsbr IS NULL
ORDER BY 1
calls.output_preview:
store_id | net | nsbr | diff | rc | rrc
(0 rows)

SELECT 'date_ts_mismatch' k, count(*) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)<>sale_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mixed test receipts', count(*) FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct p.category='ZZ Test')>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test lines in stores<900', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store999 lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id=999
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff receipts in stores', count(distinct receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales on non-trading days', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day
